Excuse me... Have you heard the rumor that one of the villagers has got some really pretty beads? When I heard that, I just wanted them so bad, I got green with envy. When I want something, I can only rest once I get my hands on it. You may think I'm a grabber, but I can't help myself. I'm so happy when I get what I want.

The Dark Elf village! The brilliant underground city and the product of our race's brilliant civilization and developed skills! The beauty is often compared to that of obsidian that shines a lucid light in the dark.
All things are temporal. Never forget that no matter how powerful one becomes, he must always eventually return to Shilen.

When war with the Elves of light was at its height, Human Mystics took sides with the Elves of light and cast strong sealing spells on Mitraell. Because of this, the morale of our forces was broken, and just as we were about to win the war, we had no choice but to retreat. Our Patriarch was a political leader, but also the central source of the black magic used by our race. Losing that power meant that our magic was greatly weakend.

I am Tetrarch Talloth of the Dark Elves -- heir of the dark Runsord Vellisark and the royal knight of Hierarch Mitraell. I am the envoy of Gran Kain who leads the hosts of darkness to the battlefield.

Sometimes I wonder if we've forgotten the truly important things in life. I once was a student studying magic. There was a time when I spent all my energy on research and discipline--hungry to put my hands on the greatest magical powers.

Enlightenment is followed by sacrifice. If you look back on the history of our race, you will truly realize the truth of this teaching. When the great Sorcerer Dasparion came to us a thousand years ago and proposed to teach us black magic, we did not anticipate the sacrifice we would have to pay in the future and accepted his proposal.

When we were at war with the Elves of the light, the black magic spells we cast wiped out the innocent Elves of the trees, due to Dasparion's malicious plots. While the Elves of the trees died, they cursed us with all their remaining strength. As a result, our beautiful forest withered, our skin became scorched by the sun, and we went blind and became the race of the Dark. For hundreds of years, we lived hidden underground.
May the mercy of Shilen shade you from the light.

Black magic is the source of our power and the revelation of dark truth. It is forbidden among other races. They do not understand darkness and fear it, so therefore they exclude it. However, if there is light, there is shadow, and we can control the true power of black magic because we confront darkness with no fear.

The craftsmen of the Elves of light are skilled indeed, but they are proud -- they look down on any metals other than mithril, and hate to even touch them. Of course, mithril is a fine material, no doubt. It is harder than iron, very lightweight, and is friendly to magic.

This island was originally the sacred ground of the Elves of Light. I heard they were powerful enchanters, who communed with spirits. At the time when the Elves began the war with the Orcs, they also began to teach Humans magic to increase their army's strength. Thus, they built the School of Wizardry here, and selected and trained magically talented Humans.

If you look down at the sea from this lighthouse, you'll get to know what tales the sea has to tell. It shows you a far different face when it's clear out than when there's a hurricane. Usually, it's calm and quiet, but there's nothin' as scary as the angry sea.

I became a lighthouse keeper because I love the sea. My wife and daughter complain that we suffer in such a small and uncultured island village, but ... the sea is the heart's refuge, and like a mother's warm love ...

Hundreds of years have passed since our race has been set free from the curse of the tree Elves. However, I still remember the pain of my flesh burning in the light of the sun. For unnumbered years we were forced to live in the darkness underground, and come to the surface only at night.

Thanks to the studies of the tetrarchs, the curse that forced us into darkness has been broken, and we have retaken the forest that used to be our home. But we still live in this underground city, and our friendship with the night to bring war and vengeance to the Elves of the light and the Humans that persecuted us.

The brothers of light that expelled us and the Humans that mocked us with wicked deception will not be forgiven. But it is true that there are times when I remember all of our people dancing together under the moonlight and enjoying poetry and music by the river a very long time ago... Perhaps we have forgotten how to enjoy life because of hatred and revenge...

Gran Kain -- Sovereign of Destruction, Father of Darkness! If the sunlight that pierces our eyes was made by Einhasad, then the darkness that swallows the light was made by the Dark Lord, Gran Kain. Other races call Gran Kain a devil, fear him and exclude his followers.

However, as the late afternoon shadow slowly overtakes the land, the power of Gran Kain will surpass all other gods -- and when the light is put out, flames extinguished, and the wind dies, the ground will part and all rivers and oceans will become dry. Then, only darkness will remain...

The place called the Sea of Spores was once a battlefield of the great war between Elves and Men. Before that, it was a beautiful place, but the battle magic of the war polluted the ground, and the blight grows wider even to this very day. They say the Mystics at the Ivory Tower have set up force fields that are just barely sufficient to contain the blight. In the fight between us Elves and the Humans, nature was the ultimate loser.

Actually, I haven't been there myself, but ... those who wanted to settle a new village went out and founded Innadril, which is far from here. They say that they built it just like our village, out of homesickness, but I'm curious what it looks like. They must have someone who manages the Mother Tree Glade there, too, don't you think? I would like to meet them someday.
for stoking the fire are pretty steep...
I have finished setting up my shop and am ready to start work. Now, what do you need?

By chance, do you have a lover? If you do, then send a letter filled with your love right now. It is no use regretting something when time has passed. When I search my memory, I can see him clearly... A long time -- so long that Humans cannot even imagine -- has passed. But still, I am happy. I have kept my promise to him, and I have my memories.

Are you learned? The world is made of light and darkness and four elements. Those four are no other than water, fire, wind and earth. All magic in this world is based on the powers of these six principles. That is why it is important, above anything else, for Mystics to understand the powers of that which composes this world.
May the blessings of the starlight shine upon you. What brings you to such a secluded place, traveler?

Do, can you believe that the structure you are looking at now was erected thousands of years ago? There are several similar relics like this around the island. They were erected in ancient times by the Elves of light that lived on the Talking Island. I think this was where the enchanters of the Elves paid tribute to the island s Hieros.

My family ran a vineyard in Gludio for generations. But two years ago, during the war with Gracia, it was all burned down by the plundering convict troops. My brother and cousins who tried to save the farm all died terrible deaths.

I've only been on this island a short time, but I love it here. It's sunny and warm with just enough rain. I think it's perfect for growing crops. I plan to start a farm here, you see. I want to forget the bad memories of the mainland and begin a new life ...

Do you know history? Before the Humans came, this island was a holy place for Elves of light. I heard they were powerful enchanters, who communed with spirits. And this ruin was the School of Wizardry built by the Elves for Humans.

Almost 700 years have passed since I first took the task of changing the professions of the Elves. I have seen many youths in my time, and there have been many stories. I feel better when I meet with a fresh youth like you. It seems as if that youth is contagious.

The romance of chivalry sung by wandering minstrels is forgotten in these ages and we Knights are scorned as relics of the old age. However, we are successors of a great legacy that has continued for over one thousand years since the age of empires, and we endure the rebukes and scorns of the worldly people and do not lose our pride for a moment as we silently stand our righteous war.

However, all living things must one day die. No matter how much they fear Shilen and try to avoid and forget her, in the end, they all rest in her embrace when they finish their lives. All are equal in Shilen's peace of death.
Welcome, traveler. This fortress is where the great siege battle occurred during the bloody wars between the Elves and Dark Elves. Many young Elves met their doom here.
I, I... shall perform miracles of light... to pu... purify the world..!

Hmm? How strange it is for someone to speak to me. Aren't you afraid of me? Everyone avoids me, whispering that I am a leper or a pagan. They are a foolish race that is afraid or jealous if something is slightly different from themselves ...
Well ...! It is rather better for me. It is comfortable not having people bother you.
They were brought into the battle to destroy the spirit of the people in Gludio, but even in their homeland they are mercenary troops that are infamous for cruelty and viciousness.

Nice to meet you, traveler. I am Leopold, commander of the third platoon of the Black Lion mercenaries. Our troops are as dignified and courageous as any Knights on this continent. We, the Black Lions, were the ones who defended the Castle of Giran when the drakes flooded Dragon Valley last summer. And we were the ones to destroy the Abellan pirates during the attack of Heine, the Floating City.

But my father could not understand. I was overwhelmed with frustration, and in my anger, declared that I would rather attain fame by becoming the greatest cook in all the land rather than a country knight that no one acknowledges, and then I left home. From then on, I've worked for more than ten years under many famous chefs and learn all their arts.
Oho! A young musician came to see me earlier! He was so talented that I was deeply moved. Perhaps I should sing a little song for you!
The mine useds to be a vast expanse consisting of hundreds of tunnels, but most of them were destroyed after the attack of the Earth Wyrm and he mithril is collected from very few tunnels now.

Welcome, young friend, to the House of Elders. My name is Lockirin Stonecutter. I am the eldest Master of the Iron Gate Guild and also the First Elder of the Association of Guild Elders. These titles sound fine enough, but really my job is to keep these headstrong old chaps in line.
Of course, the Kingdom of the Dwarves pays tribute to the Kingdom of Elmore, but that is only fair because Elmore prevents the Orcs, who can always invade us from the west, from attacking us.

We of the Bronze Key Guild are an association of Dwarves whose motto is to do anything for the client, even if that means fetching a dragon's tooth! Our job is to collect the rare and precious materials that craftsmen from many guilds need to make their wares! We are the guild of pioneers, traders and explorers, and we are willing to follow the thorniest path to find new materials and rare resources! Moreover, since we travel everywhere, our guild has the best cartography and navigation techniques.
Repeat this deep down in your heart if you want her blessing! Carna Maphra, must not be forgotten. This is the holy name of the Goddess. Carna Maphra.

Great Maphr, the goddess of the earth created us Dwarves by infusing the power of the earth and the spirit of the light of Einhasad. It is also said that the goddess gave us the ability to create anything in accordance with the law of the universe. Always acknowledge her gift and be thankful. All of our abilities are gifts of grace given by the great Maphr.

Earth Wyrm Trasken was one of the wicked devils created by Shilen, the goddess of darkness and death. Long ago, when Shunaiman, the king of Elmoreden, was building the Seal of Shilen, Earth Worm Trasken escaped from King Shunaiman, the tales tell us. It is said that Trasken settled here, and was sleeping deep within the Spine Mountains, where we live now.
One more thing! There are tribes of traitors that betrayed their own kind! Their names are forgotten!
I, the son of Haros, the shield of Uruchatte, and one of the 6 great heroes, remember!

Hear, young Orc!! Let me explain the origin of our race! In the beginning, there was Paagrio of the flame, and from the hot flame Paagrio brought forth the the father of the Orcs. His hair was a red blaze, his eyes a pure white flame, ashen smoke rushed out of his nose and mouth as he breathed, and in his veins boiled blood hotter than lava! Because of all this, he was mightier than any other living thing!

But when he came down from the heavens, the heat of his body began to cool, because of the force of the water. His lava blood began to harden, because of the force of the earth. His smoke was scattered, because of the force of the wind. The father of the Orcs was miserable because he had lost his original strength, but the god Paagrio taught him that if he continuously trained his body through discipline and combat, he could become strong again. From then on, his descendants have been pursuing strength and power and the glory of our bloody history begins!
The land around here used to be fertile farmland before the terrible war with Gracia. It was a peaceful place where simple farmers like me tilled the land to make a living.

Start out by hunting keltirs or wolves around the village. When you find an item left behind by a monster you slay, try equipping the armor or weapon, and see if it's better than what you already have. If you have no other use for it, you can always sell it at the shop.

Whatever you have is fine for now. Remember to pay attention to what you find while hunting monsters -- you can find armor, and sometimes even weapons, in the wild. If you're lucky, you might find cloth shoes, apprentice's shoes or a cloth cap.

You should have been given two weapons, a dagger and a squire's sword. Perhaps you have already noticed that daggers and swords perform differenty in battle. the dagger is swift, but its accuracy suffers, while the squire's sword is noticeably slower than the dagger, but strikes with greater accuracy. Remember that different weapons may call upon different skills in their use. Either is a worthy weapon; it is up to you to decide which suits you best.

And I warn you, don't try to tangle with the orcs yet. Orcs are smarter and stonger than you think, but the most dangerous thing is that they know about teamwork -- if you attack one, several others may come to its aid. Even if you might have a chance against a single orc, you won't be able to stand against two or three.

Now, pay attention; you'll need SP to gain your skills, SP is short for skill ponits, and they're earned along with experience whenever you defeat a monster, SP are deducted whenever you learn a new skill. You can check your SP by clicking the Character Status button, the on the Status tab in the window. Of course, the number of SP you need will vary, depending on the skill you're after.

Consider where you wish to finish, and that will tell you where to start. The Kingdom of Aden is in chaos, because they are at war with Elmore, and with Gracia across the sea. What better time will there be to restore the Elven people to their ancient greatness?

Begin your training by hunting red keltirs or wolves near the village. Be cautious, particularly with the wolves, for they are very savage. When you find an item after slaying a monster, try to equip any armour or weapon, and see if it's better than what you have now. For the rest, if you have no other use for it, sell it at the stores, so you will have adena when you need it.

You should have been given two weapons - a dagger and a squire's sword. Perhaps you have already noticed that daggers and swords perform differently in battle. The dagger is swift, but its accuracy suffers, while the squire's sword is noticeably slower than the dagger, but strikes with greater accuracy. Remember that different weapons may call upon different skills in their use. Either is a worthy weapon; it is up to you to decide which suits you best. When you have saved around 500 adena, buy a bone dagger if that's what you prefer, or a short sword if swords are more to your taste.

You may be able to improve your armour from the spoils of te monsters you slay, but that is a matter of luck. If you reach level 5 and are still lacking gloves, shoes or a helmet, you should consider purchasing the cheapest ones offered by the store.

Around level 6 you should be able to challenge the Kaboo Orcs that lurk beyond the southwestern edge of the village, or the past the southeastern gate. Remember, though, that orcs are more dangerous than they seem, for if you attack one several others may come to its aid.

If you have been alert, you may have noticed that when you defeat monster, you gain SP along with experience. SP stands for 'skill points'. If you are curious about SP, click the Character Status button and view the Status tab on the window. You must expend SP for each individual skill you acquire.

You may begin to learn skills when you reach level 5. Training in skills may be obtained at the Temple of Shilen, where the masters and elders stay. The Temple is the largest building in the village, north of the village square. The masters there will teach you. First, however, you will need to acquire SP before you can obtain skills, SP stands for skill points, and like experience, they are earned by defeating monsters. SP are deducted when you learn a new skill. If you are curious about you SP, click the Character Status button and view the Status tab on the window. You must expand SP for each individual skill you acquire.
Let's see... ah, yes! See that you speak to Collette and to Trader Payne as well.

So practice your hunting skills on longtail keltirs, or gremlin scavengers around the village. When you find items left behind by your prey, try equipping the weapons and armor to see if they're better than what your've already got. As for the rest, if you have no use for it you can always sell it at the shops for pocket money.

When you reach Level 5 you'll start studying your skills, Skills are taught at the Iron Gate Guild -- thewarehouse, as they call it-by the east gate, or the Black Anvil Guild - it looks like a blacksmith's shop if you look east from the square at the north gate, Now, this is important you'll need SP to gain your skills, SP is short for skill points, and they're earned along with experience whenever you defeat a monster, SP are deducted whenever you learn a new skill,You can check yourSP by clicking the Character Status button, then on the Status tab in the window, Of course, the number of SP you need will vary, depending on the skill you're after.

Skills are divided into active skills and passive skills, Active skills have to be deliberately used by you, while passive skills increase your basic abilities from the moment you learn them. We Dwarves like creating things more than destroying them, so we don't teach active skills about destroying. Study the master's list, and think about what you'll want to learn in the future as well. If you work hard to earn enough SP, you'll pick up a skill around Level 7. The Create Item skill, which lets you... well, it lets you create items, OK? Now that's a good Dwarven skill. Think about getting that one.
What do you want me to teach you first? A novice like you is pretty ignorant, but we can fix that. Just listen to what I have to teach.

Start out by hunting crimson keltirs or kasha wolves around the village. When you find items left behind by the monsters you slay, try equipping the armour and weapons, to see if they're better than what you already have. If you have no other use for them, you can always sell them at a shop.

Whatever you have is fine for now. Remember to pay attention to what you find while hunting monsters - you can find armour, and sometimes even weapons, in the wild. If you're lucky, you might find cloth shoes, apprentice's shoes, or a cloth cap.

And I warn you, don't try to tangle with the goblins yet. Goblins are smarter and stronger than you think, but the most dangerous thing is that they know about teamwork. If you attack one, several others may come to its aid. Even if you might have a chance against a single goblin, you won't be able to stand against two or three.

Now, pay attention; you'll need SP to gain your skills. SP is short for "skill points", and they're earned along with the experience whenever you defeat a monster. SP are deducted whenever you learn a new skill. You can check your SP by clicking the Character Status button, then on the Status tab in the window. Of course, the number of SP you need will vary, depending on the skill you're after.

In the past, even the Lords of the land came to us for tellings... But people often fear what they cannot understand and fortune telling has had an unfavorable light shone upon it by religious types. I can no longer practice my skill in the open, only in small, insignificant places, like here.
Yes, I am Cronos. I was born in the time before even your great-great grandfather. I am even older than you King! I have forgotten more than you could possibly ever comprehend. Do you understand?

Would you like to hear stories of my splendid past? In my youth I was a soldier of fortune, wandering freely, fighting aliens and making love to women with foreign names. There were some hard times, but my blazing Warrior spirit kept me going. The deep brotherhood among comrades, struggles, fierce battles, love, romance, I experience it all. I was truly a Warrior.
I lost my wife and children during Gracia's attack. The Gracian army is my lifelong enemy because they have deprived me of my most precious thing, my family. I swear that I will avenge them some day.

My name is Orim and I serve the great Wizard Hardin as my master. I am searching for truth, in this deserted land where the dark shadows of the land dragon, Antharas, lie. If all that remains in the light, admired by most, is hypocrisy perhaps then, the truth really lies in darkness.

This was where the stadium of the empirical era stood. Even today... Don't you think it'd be a good place to hold a battle? Like a Summoner's duel, for instance... Ah, excuse me for my late introduction. I am Celestiel the Summoner. And that is my comrade Pantersm, the unicorn. Please try not to stir him up since he is quite an ill-tempered boy.

The time of chaos is at hand, and will bring endless war, confusion, massacre, and battle! I, Gandi Chief Chianta, declare! You must become strong in order to live! Only the powerful shall become the owners of the new age!
Who are you? If you're not here to learn, then get out of my light!
The myth that you believed until this day, is all wrong. Let's study the truth of Grand Kain and Shilen together! And let's bring life again to this rotten world!
May the blessings of the starlight shine upon you. Hello, young traveler. Welcome to the Hunters Village.

I have something to confess. The depth of my sin is deeper than a well... Until the day I pay off the debt of my sin, and until justice settles down on this land of Dion, I shall not be able to live in peace. I do not dare to...

Humans have committed the grandest mistakes of all races. Known sins... Unknown sins. I, Cardinal Seresin, think that humankind should apologize to other races and recover the trust. We should all work to combine our forces against evil before it becomes too powerful...
I am Father Gupu. The orphanage I work for here is for little girls... I think that it's much more difficult to look after boys... Who am I kidding? Girls aren't any easier at all!

I am here to spread the word of light to the forest of darkness. The Chaotic Chronicle is approaching. We must all prepare for the disaster it will bring. Not only Humans, but the Elves, and Dark Elves, together...

Well, as you already probably know, the town is to the northwest, and the southeast... It is divided into two large areas like this. The shops are lined up above, and several guilds are situated on the bottom. These two areas are divided by a large canyon, and if you happen to fall into it you will have a hard time climbing back up. So be carefull

Are you here to join the guild? Well, we aren't accepting any new members. Or could it be that you are here for something else? Ask anything, I will attempt to answer your questions with the utmost respect.

Currently our 3rd platoon, the main force of our mercenary troop is fighting a important battle in Gludio against the Ol Mahum Stragglers. The 2nd platoon has been dispatched to drive out the evil spirits of the Wasteland. Captain Leopold who is stationed in Gludin, is better informed about the details of the situation there...
If you plan to travel in the vicinity of Gludio or Giran you should prepare yourself for attack from an Enku Orc or a dire wolf. You look skillful enough, I expect that you will survive.

Currently our 3rd platoon, the main force of our mercenary troop, is fighting an important battle in Gludio against the ol mahum stragglers. The 2nd platoon has been dispatched to drive out the evil spirits of the Wasteland. Captain Leopold, who is stationed in Gludin, is better informed about the details of the situation there...

Are you looking for me? Why? Are you going to kill me too? Unlike the other wyrms down there, I don t have any intention of attacking you& But, are you still going to try to kill me? Somebody stole the eggs of me and my fellow wyrms. We have been going to all different parts of the continent looking for our lost eggs...

I've heard others openly proclaim their desire for anarchy... of chaos. But rule must be maintained, a system must be established so that others cannot slip in unhindered and sow the seeds of tyranny. As the saying goes, my friend, better the devil you know, than the devil you don't.
A large wooden box, carved with an exquisite decorative pattern.

Oh, you mean this cave? It is very well-suited to the needs of my pupils and myself. Does it seems a little rustic? Lich King Icarus could answer more of your questions about this place. He was the original owner here.

The Elves of Innadril originally came here from the Elven Forest around ED. 1200. Tetrarch Terestien and his young followers settled in the Emerald Forest near Innadril Lake. This was the beginning of the Elven migration to Innadril. Since our peoples share a devotion to the goddess we have always gotten along well. Over time intermarriage between the races has given most of the people of this area some Elven ancestry. This has enhanced both their beauty and lifespan.

Working under the shadow of the Ivory Tower, I often admire its graceful beauty. It reminds me of a delicate porcelain vase, that but with the slightest bit of mishandling would shatter into millions of pieces.

Don't you get it?! This tower is itself a battleground! I don't know what is on the top floor, only that there are many who seek it. Worst among them are Death Lord Hallate and his legion. Hallate is responsible for the destruction of the force field that once protected the tower.

Where to find a Dimensional Stone? Ah...that... my collegues and I found a chest with a Dimensional Stone, but... A demon servant of Hallant came and attacked, so we gave them all away... If you need a Dimensional Stone, you should loot them from the demons lurking around the tower...
Anyway, the conflicts between Hallate's legion and the Platinum tribe and the angels guarding the tower have reduced the entire tower to a battleground.

Earlier, the Gatekeepers from the Ivory Tower stopped by for an investigation, and they said the land near the tower was twisted and torn... that's why the teleport spell wouldn't work. It's probably a defense mechanism made by the tower's architects, something like a preventive measure to stop intruders from mobilizing large armies.

Members of the Platinum tribe resemble wolves. They may also appear somewhat similar to the Ol Mahums, but they worship the goddess of light. It is their sacred duty to kill any invaders who enter the Tower of Insolence. Their devotion can be quite deadly and they should be avoided when at all possible...
The problem is that it's really difficult to get them, especially the Red Dimensional Stone - Platinum Tribes and angels have them. Maybe the steps would be a better option for you?
Hey! How long have you been standing there? Have you been eavesdropping on me?
It feels like it's going to rain again today... I've got a pretty good sense for these things. I can taste it on the wind.

Welcome, you fresh-faced traveller! I am a musician, an artisan of melodies. Music is the finest blessing bestowed upon us by Eva, the goddess of art. When your feeling blue, as I sometimes do, nothing cheers you up like a cheerful tune played on the accordian! It will lighten the darkest mood!

There are two types of race betting. The Win type betting means that you back a monster that will win the first prize. Place type of betting means that you will have to guess the 1st and 2nd winning monsters, regardless of who finishes first or second.

* Among the entire betting amount for Win betting, after subtracting the race track's own share of profit, the amount left will be your total winnings. Three minutes before the race each monster's expected odds are announced. Each Win ticket's dividend amount is calculated by multiplying the odds by the price of a ticket. The odds rate is never less than 1.<br1>

* Place betting is a way of betting when you correctly guess the two monsters who will finish first and second regardless of their order. The method of calculating dividend amount is the same as Win betting.
* Currently place betting is not offered.

The lighthouse was built by the Elves long ago, to safely guide ships and their crews to Talking Island. Now Rockswell manages the lighthouse. For the past thirty years, he hasn't missed a night, and so the sea is lit by the lighthouse's beams.

Nice to meet you, young friend. I am Captain Gilbert. Our guards maintain the peace in the village and work day and night to protect the residents from ferocious beasts or orcs, just like the lighthouse works constantly to protect ships from the rocks.
If you are planning to leave the village, ask the guards about getting around on the island. We wouldn't want you to suffer misfortune, lost in a forest full of orcs and wolves.

During Aden's unification war, Sir Cedric served King Raoul and performed meritorious deeds on the battlefield. He lived his entire life true to the spirit of chivalry and the will of Einhasad. He is the model for all young fighters of the kingdom, and a living legend.
You can take a regular liner to the mainland of Gludio. The boat fare is a little expensive, but your journey will be safe.

Hello! My name is Abellos. For now, I am merely a guard here on this little island, but some day I may seek my fortune on the great continent across the sea. When I've saved enough money, I plan to buy a ticket to Gludio at the harbor.

It used to be the Elven school of magic, but it has become a ruin since it was abandoned a long time ago. It is very dangerous now because of the undead and spirits that roam the dust-filled corridors. Of course, a few fellows have set off for the place with hopes of finding forgotten treasure.

It is a tower built by the Elves who lived on this island a long time ago. As I heard it, it was erected to celebrate victory in a battle between the Elves and Orcs 2,000 years ago. At the time, the Elves won the war because Humans joined the Elven forces.
Ahh... What is it?! Can't you see I'm on duty? This soldier has no time to chatter leisurely with the likes of you, country wanderer. Don't be a nuisance. Do me a favor and disappear from my sight.
I tell you again, the marshlands where the cruma lived are very, very dangerous. I think it is better to give up going there.

Greetings. I sincerely welcome you to our village. There are many dangerous areas around here, so you must be particularly careful when you travel. Be especially careful from that point past the temple in front of me, where you can see the ruins left by the giants of ere. You never know when or where some monster will make a surprise attack on you.

I myself have never been to the Bazaar of Giran. However, our village frequently trades with the Bazaar, so I know a little about what it is like there. It is a place where there are all sorts of priceless items. If you can't find it there, then you won't be able to find it anywhere in Aden. It's an enjoyable, lively village. If I have the chance, I should like to go someday.

It is risky to speak of such things, but I will trust you and tell you. It is the Execution Grounds of a rebel army of farmers who revolted against the lord's severe rule a few years ago. At the time, the lord cruelly and publicly executed all those involved in the revolt, and their families, as an example to the people. Those who were unjustly killed became the undead, and they haunt the Execution Grounds to this day.

The blue dragon Fafurion is almost as strong as the green dragon Antharas, which is supposed to be horrible. Usually, it stays in the water -- I suppose that means it's somewhere on the bottom of Lake Innadril. When I think that two dragons are so near our village ... well, it makes it hard to live a worry-free life, don't you think?

I sometimes talk with my friend Reikin about what the water dragon Fafurion would look like. It s truly hard to imagine that Fafurion lives in Innadril Lake, just east from here. If that dragon ever ventured upon our village, complete annihilation would only be a matter of time, don t you think?

As you know, we are close to Aden's enemy, the land of Elmore, so security is tighter here than in most towns. Let me apologize now for any inconvenience this may cause you.
Please understand, the residents here are not very different in either appearance or customs, to our neighbors to the north. In fact, to those who make their living cutting down trees, national boundaries mean little. Off the top of my head, I can name at least 10 residents who have relatives or friends in Elmore!

Eh, nice weather, eh stranger? I've been a guard for a long time but, honestly, I've never even gotten a scratch in the line of duty. I am lucky. Really, even though you're a skilled adventurer, you'll never be able to beat someone who's lucky. One of my friends... He was so drunk one time, he didn't even have his armor on, went and wandered off by the protection towers,, near the Sea of Spores to take a leak, and didn't even see a monster. Lucky bastard.

Have you heard, that there is the Enchanted Valley, east of our town? You can capture various creatures there. That is why Hunters made a little village there, but some of the Hunters had other jobs besides being Hunters. Well, people with various backgrounds with various jobs live there.
There are other places, besides the ones I've mentioned, that are dangerous too; if you want to know more, ask other guards. I know a little about the Enchanted Valley... Are you interested?

Perhaps that is why, when we rest under the shade of the Mother Tree Glade, our bodies and souls all feel at ease. When we are tired and weary, there is nothing better than resting under the shade of the Mother Tree Glade.
May the blessing of starlight rest upon you. My name is Wheeler, one of the sentinels of the forest.

This forest may seem peaceful at first glance, but terrible enemies lurk within. For hundreds of years, our kingdom was under attack by the Orcs of the Misty Mountains, the fungus from the Sea of Spores, and the giant spiders from the Wasteland of Gludio.
May the blessing of moonlight be with you... My name is Veltress, one of the sentinels. We are called the watch of the forest.

The Underground Fortress was the final stronghold in the battle with Humans, and an important stronghold in the war with the Elves. It was the site of several offensive and defensive battles as well. In the end, the demons summoned by the Dark Elven enchanters completely razed the fortress with fire, and the Elven fighters who were defending it were brutally murdered.
May the song of stars give you happiness. I am Starden, one of the sentinels who protect the forest, the Mother Tree Glade, and Elves of light.

If my expression looks dark, then forgive me. Originally, I was a cheerful elf who enjoyed poetry and singing, but now I've lost all my former optimism since I went through the war. I had to look upon the sight of my friends being brutally killed by the Dark Elves at the final battle of the Underground Fortress ... I try hard to forget the fear and sorrow of those times, but I still have nightmares once in a while.
Ask about the final battle of the Underground Fortress

Gludio is the largest region in the Human Kingdom of Aden. However, it was attacked by another Human Kingdom called Gracia from overseas a few years ago, so parts of the region have burned down. Since history began, Humans have always enjoyed cruel wars in this way.
May the wind of the forest lead you to peace. I am the sentinel Rayen. Our duty is to drive away those who try to attack our forest and village.

Oh, and by the way, don't think about borrowing money from me. These days I'm thinking of a new business so I'm putting a hold on money lending. I should go pursue sales in a Human village or something ...
They say the Elves of light also have guards called Sentinels. But please, do not compare us with the weak Elves.

Sentinels are also called the guardians of the forest, or watchmen of the fresh green. We are fighters who have guarded the Elven Forest from outside threats for hundreds of years. The orcs of the Fog Mountains, greedy Humans trying to increase their land, and our dark Elven brothers of the north -- all have attacked this place many times. Each time we defend ourselves, and they learn a harsh lesson about underestimating the sentinels.
The building you see behind me is the Sanctuary of Eva -- the elders that guide the Elves of Light dwell here. It is also a place for young Elves to train in swordsmanship and magic.

May the blessing of the starlight fall upon you. My name is Gartrandell, one of the sentinels who guard the forest and the Mother Tree Glade. I left the forefront because I was injured in the war with the Dark Elves, and now I guard the Sanctum of Eva.
The Sanctum of Eva is home to splendid Elven cultural relics, so I am proud of my job. I am also pleased that I can stay a little closer to my sweetheart.

Welcome, young traveler! I am Captain Bathis, the commander of the guard that provides security to both this village and the surrounding area. May I offer you a word of advice? What kind of outfit are you wearing? I understand the desire to be fashionable, particularly among the young...but armor is not for looks. Choose a set capable of protecting you in battle, regardless of what it looks like. Tsk tsk! Young people these days...

The region of Gludio was the center of battle in the war with Gracia. After the Gracian army withdrew, the lord began an active restoration project, and we are recovering much of its former beauty, but there are still open wounds of war like the

The Ruins of Despair were originally the village of Lostern. Before the war, it was a prosperous farm village, but the Gracian army reduced it to ashes. The ghosts of the soldiers that were cruelly slaughtered while trying to protect the village still roam there, with their swords and bows, not knowing that the war is over.

If you go a little farther down from there, you will come to the Neutral Zone, which was created by an agreement with the Elves. If you go east from there, you will come to the Elven Forest where the arrogant Elves live. They are a race that thinks they are the most noble in the world.

When our race lived deep underground to avoid the sunlight, Tetrarch Vellior performed various experiments with the low creatures called gremlins, which lived underground, and created a new species called imps.

They honored our name and served us loyally for hundreds of years. However, they somehow undid the spells of restraint, killing their overseers and escaping. We were at war with the Elves of light at the time, so we weren't able to do anything about it.
The Gracian invasion force crossed the sea and attacked our kingdom not long after his majesty had ascended the throne. Many innocents lost their lives in the savage attack.

Long ago, Orc tribes lived freely in Gludio. When we Humans came to this place we drove them out. As of yet there have been no reprisals for our actions. But now they are under the sway of a new chief, Burai, and the situation has changed. They now occupy the fertile farmland located in northwest Gludio and are staging a sit-in! Truly, I do sympathize with their cause, but this act of aggression cannot go unanswered. We have spent too many years cultivating that farmland...

Young traveler, welcome to the most historic village in Gludio! This is the first village that the Humans established after moving to this area and driving out the lizardmen and the orcs. We have been through great misfortune, such as the domination of the demon Beleth and the battle with Gracia, but each time our people have defended this village with courage and spirit.

It is a vast forest to the northeast in Oren and is the headquarters of the Dark Elves. They have a deep-rooted feud against the Elves of light, and so the two enemies have come to blows on occasion, but now they have signed a peace agreement.

When the war broke out, the people who were unable to escape to Gludio Castle all flocked to the village of Bernice. They thought they could withstand the attack of the invaders because the village had a stone outer wall. The lord's men, who suffered retreat after retreat, positioned themselves using the village as a stronghold. Einhasad's priests who were healing the wounded also stayed at the village.

The troops fought off the attack of the Gracian army a few times, and began to hope that the villagers would live. However, it was of no use. The Gracian army had joined forces with the foreign troops of ol mahum. Those violent degenerates broke the outer wall and swarmed into the village, slaughtering soldiers, priests, farmers and anyone else in sight. They also set all the buildings on fire.

Beleth is a demon that led the legions of the undead, and attempted to make an eternal empire of darkness in this land. However, the wise men of the Ivory Tower and the Elven Mystics joined forces, and with their powers sealed him underground.

The Neutral Zone begins right after crossing this bridge. After the war between the Elves and Dark Elves, the area was designated as a Neutral Zone to prevent conflict. It has played its role as a buffer zone for a long time.

May the twinkle of starlight become a beautiful song that wholly fills your soul. I am Trionell, one of the sentinels who guard the Elven Forest. This place is the Neutral Zone which was made when the Elves and Dark Elves signed a peace agreement.

A few years ago in Dion, the farmers revolted against the lord. The Lord Ashton of that time hired soldiers to suppress the revolt and executed all those who were involved as an example. There are many rumors that the ghosts of the farmers that were murdered still haunt the grounds, so no one goes near there.

Growing mandragoras definitely guarantees a high profit, but if you are not careful you could lose your life. It is a dangerous plant. When you pass the Mandragora Farm, make sure to cover your ears, or their cries will rip your eardrums.

You are a new face. Have you come from foreign lands? You must know that Dion s local specialty is the mandragora! Well then, do you know where the largest Mandragora Farm in Dion is? If you just follow the road in front of me, you can take a look at Aaron Nightshade's Mandragora Farm, the largest mandragora operation in Dion.
Look here, are you going to the Mandragora Farms by any chance? If I were you, I'd think again about visiting there. It's a very unsettling place.
Ask about the Mandragora Farm

What? Are you kidding me? You don't know the Spine Mine? It is where we live now -- the home of us Dwarves and also a working mine! We left our prosperous kingdom of the west when it was overrun by those merciless Orcs, and we settled down here! I think of it as a case of good coming out of evil. These Spine Mountains are full of treasures, ha ha ha ...
Seriously, you haven't heard of Hero Lucien? No, you're kidding aren't you? Seriously, you're putting me on, right?.
Oh, I should introduce myself! I'm Nathan, a Defender of this village. I must stand guard no matter how cold the winter gets!

Immortal Plateau! The region where our Orcs live is called the Immortal Plateau. Originally, it was a sacred place for worshipping our ancestors. However, 2,000 years ago we were defeated by the Elves and we settled here to live.
Let me give you a free word of advice... You may soon meet someone in the company of his minions... Don't get distracted by them! Got it? No matter what, only attack the leader!

Welcome, stranger. I am Captain Raigen. Hunters Village was first formed by hunters who attempted to catch unique monsters in the Enchanted Valley and Forest of Mirrors. The Lord of Aden respects the town's unique makeup and acknowledges, to some extent, its autonomy.
The hunters here are a little bit different from those elsewhere so please be careful not to offend anyone. If a problem occurred, it would be very humiliating for us.
Many adventurers have attempted to slay this dragon, and all have perished.

In the past it was known as the Forest of Doppelgangers. Monsters there masqueraded as known Men and attacked unwary victims... Honestly I have never seen my doppelganger. It is said the you will die instantly if you do...
A few months ago a farmer thought that he saw one but it was only his friends playing a joke on him...
Recently they have been dropping High-level Spellbooks occasionally. Until now the knowledge of these books has been quite rare.
The gatekeeper will assist your passage between the floors. You may not use the stairs.
I fear blowback from the recent war with Elmore. My precious little sister has gone to that forsaken region for her wedding! I shouldn't have allowed it!

The Sea of Spores? Please don't mention that name! Even now it makes me uncomfortable. It is a foul place, glutted with rotten mushrooms, fungus and zombies roaming about. Honestly, you will not find another place like it. A war between Men and Elves a long time ago left the sea into its current state...

Aden Castle was built in the style of the Titans, supported by enormous columns that give it an aura of invicibility. It is practically impervious to attack. Even if all the armies of Elmore attacked simultaneously, this castle could be easily defended with only five thousand men...

This castle is most vulnerable to internal dangers... Our task as guards is to protect against attack from foreign armies, as well as to prevent the infiltration of people who wish to bring harm upon the city.

Nothing more than the Goddard territory of Elmore. There's a settlement I know there called Goddard Village, extremely impoverished since the war. While his citizens starve Elmore still plans another attack upon Aden. He has raised huge offensive castles! I pity the people that live there...

Having the border so close to the capital city makes me very nervous. Things have quited down now, but if Elmore were tp attack I fear that the border guards would not be able to resist at all. There was talk for a while of opening the border entirely, but now they seem to be on a higher level of alert than ever before. I pray that nothing triggers the resumption of hostilities...

Well... There's tairim... It's like a bundle of fire that just floats around in the air... The undead called by the grand name of marsh judge... The giant rats called tulben.. You know about gargoyles, right? The marsh stalkers are also very dangerous. But the most threatening thing is the marsh drake. It's similar to other drakes but comes attacking with fire...

The swamp to the north of Aden Castle is called the Blazing Swamp. The name makes one think of some hellish sea of fire that is covered in molten rock or something... But looking at it from the outside, it really doesn't seem much different than any other marsh. However, the monsters that come out of it are a bit peculiar. Paagrio did something there... And so they are all masters of the fire line of magic... King Raoul gave the order that a waterway be dug at the edge of the marsh to prevent the spreading of fires to the area around. But the most famous thing about the Blazing Swamp happened when King Amadeo was attacked by Elmore... Oh, right. It wouldn't be good for you to know about this long-winded story.

You might already know about this but that place is where the depraved god Shilen gave birth to six dragons and then changed them into death goddesses. According to the legend, the army of light defeated the depraved god but was not able to kill the goddesses that control the world of darkness and so they are sealed in that place. Therefore, there are a lot of religious researchers, clergymen and fanatics gathered there...

And there are strange ones that want to kill not just the Dark Elves that serve Shilen but also those that serve the god of light, as well as other gods, which they regard as being cults. The crazy ones that fight saying they will release the seal of Shilen have plenty to do... And there are many watchers sent by the religious bodies in order to stop all those blasphemous ones. These watchers are in utter dissolutionment because of the depravity of this age... Therefore, I'm entreating you that if you go there, please avoid any actions which could have any chance of being misunderstood. I mean, regardless of whether they are fanatics of Shilen or watchers of the seal... OK?

No, it's nothing special. It's just the useless chatter of crazy fanatics. It has been said that, a long time ago, when Shilen caused a war against Einhasad and lost, for some reason, the gods didn't kill Shilen but rather sealed her into the location that we are speaking of now...

Are you a traveler? Why have you come to Aden Castle Town? You're not actually planning on going to the Shilen Holy Place to the east of the National Cemetary, are you? If you're intending to go there, I'll need to investigate various matters about you here.
This is the border between the kingdoms of Aden and Elmore. You can't cross over without a passport. No matter who you are...
Since the war, I have been serving in the military& It is much better now than during the war because now I don t have to worry about putting my life in jeopardy&
I'll go crazy if I stay here! That Valacas expedition team is looking better all the time!
The Varka are the most powerful tribe among the Silenos! During the war with Aden, our late king hired them as mercenaries. Unfortunately, after the war they settled down in this region.

Hey, stranger! You'd better be careful if you leave this village! Things have gotten very dangerous out there! Tensions have reached the boiling point between the Varka Silenos of the west and the Ketra Orcs of the north! Even if they kill each other off, there are worse beasts to replace them! Well, come to think of it, if they kill each other off, our guards would have things a bit easier...

You must be new to Goddard! The hot springs are the result of a volcanic fault line. There is an excellent resort to the north of here that features an excellent hot springs! Unfortunately, ferocious beasts seem to be attracted to the smell of Sulfur in the water there... You may find it a bit hard to relax...
Someone else told me that Bigfoot was seen there, too! Getting into a UFO! Are you listening to me? This is important stuff!

Raising wild animals is not as easy as it may seem. In the end, the military gave up on the project. Once they withdrew their funding, the farm was abandoned by all but a few die-hards, who can't seem to give up the business of raising wild beasts. It's also said that sometimes young adventurers like yourself go hunting there...

The pasture of wild beasts in the northern part of this village is one of our most popular attractions! I don't understand why anyone would want to keep such ferocious animals! Are they crazy or what?

No matter how much you love peace, if you're not firm against evil, peace will be elusive. Don't you agree? The goddess of myth also used physical force to achieve justice and peace. We believe that we should punish evil by any means necessary.

I've had enough of danger myself, thank you! I'd rather stay home and relax with my georgeous wife! When the stakatos are driven out of the Swamp of Screams and the land is cultivated, I'll be the first to build my own farm!
To make matters worse, government officials stand by without taking any action! They waste time with idiotic witch hunts and purging innocent priests!

Is this your first time here? This is a dangerous place for adventurers, my friend! Captain Vishotsky keeps the peace here, but the forest out there is a different matter! All sorts of vicious monsters lurk just outside the walls of this village! Even the mighty Vishotsky can't kill all of them!

But something dreadful happened to Preya, and she became the horrifying witch that we now call the Ice Queen. Since that day, the whole region has been covered in snow and ice! her bitterness must have caused it... Still, I'm sure the Ice Castle is a wonder to behold!

Ha! If you're lost, I'm your man! I was born and raised here! I know every nook and cranny of Schuttgart! Hee, hee. Oh, the Pavel Ruins? Humm... Well, go down the paved road in the southern part of town until you see the "Expedition Party Temporary Headquarters". The Pavel Ruins are east and west of there.

Hmm, how to explain it.... Basically, the ruins are haunted! At one time it was a thriving Orcish city, but now it's just a shell of its former self. Only inhabitants you'll find out there are evil spirits and insects! They say that if you bury a bottle of liquor under the ruins, you'll get an amazing Kofporch! I've heard there's even an old Kofporch jug buried under the Beacon Mound of Pa'agrio! If I could have a glass of that, I'd die a warm and happy man!

Kofporch is only brewed in a few areas in Schuttgart Territory. The best kinds are then hauled out and left to age in either the Den of Evil or the Crypts of Disgrace. Dangerous? Sure! But believe you me, no imitation even comes close!

The Plunderous Plains are as dreary as they sound! An old railroad crosses them, and goes all the way to Schuttgart Castle. There's a Strip Mine in the east that was abandoned by the Dwarves, and an old harbor in the south. When traveling there you must beware of the gangs of bandits and Kobolds. I must get back to work now. Goodbye.

Haures: Subordinate of Tanakia, a Fallen Angel. Haures is accompanied by his minions. Rumors say that he tends to overwork his subordinates, and they are vulnerable to Sleep magic. Since Haures is a devil, he's vulnerable to Sacred Energy magic. If you have Holy magic, attack him with it. If you don't, run away!

Chimera Golem: Created as a result of research conducted by hermits, the golem escaped the research center. Although a few years have passed, victims attacked by the golem are still being found. This article was written to prepare for an encounter.

(Omission) Unlike other golems, it can run very fast, but only temporarily. It has a sturdy body, but can be easily attacked when worked up due to the hate skill series. It's likely to be reckless when stimulated. It's best to avoid the golem entirely.
Don't forget, his nickname on the battlefield is "The Stress Storm". He relies too much on his flawless defense capability when he attacks. You must defend yourself to the utmost of your ability!
Ultimate Defense is often successful against his attack.

However, the ritual is impenetrable in only one aspect, and leaves another aspect quite vulnerable. Elven defenses can be overcome by psychological attacks such as Hate, but beware the guardian's swordsmanship.
The Song of Whisper removes the listener's desire to attack. The Antidote for this is the Song of Water.

Ajirua imparts a strong reflective ability in addition to<font color="LEVEL"> Burning Fist</font>, which fills your fist with the power of Paagrio, or the<font color="LEVEL"> Soul Breaker</font>, which can shatter a dead soul. When Ajirua awakes, he becomes an evil being. It's the duty of a grand Khavatari to slay him.</body></html>

Iconoclasis reacts to physical and magical attacks in the same manner as other evil spirits...

(Omission)... to summarize, Iconoclasis can be very dangerous. But, if the proper strategy is applied, you have a good chance of defeating him. The best weapon against him is a blunt weapon. Of course, you must defend yourself against the Bead of Holy Flame before you can attack Iconoclasis...

First Guideline: Shakiel must always be confronted alone. He appears when a single person attempts to commune with the tablet. If he's attacked by a person other than the original summoner, he disappears.
The Crown of Thorns provides Shakiel a high degree of resistance against magic. Even more disturbing, any attack upon him while the Crown of Thorns is activated are reflected back onto the attacker.

Shakiel is of the same level as the other archangels, Shuriel and Barakiel. Even a high-ranking warlock can't subdue him without the help of a high-level Kat. However, when the crown is active, the summoner must order a halt to the attack. Otherwise, he'll be injured by blowback. Place the mouse cursor over the location to which you want to move and click the left button of your mouse. Your character will move to that location.

Before sitting, be certain that you are in a place that is free of aggressive monsters. If you are attacked while seated, your counter-attack will be delayed and your character will suffer more damage.

Moving the mouse while pressing down the right mouse button changes your character's point-of-view. This flexible change of viewpoint is especially useful during hunting, when your character has to look around for monsters.
Click the right mouse button again and the default POV will be restored.

Clicking on the mouse wheel button, changes your point-of-view (POV) so that you are facing the front of your character. Clicking again changes it back to the default POV. This feature is especially useful when you are being pursued by monsters or trying to keep a party together.

The letter N on the radar indicates the direction North. Changing the direction of your character rotates the radar accordingly. Therefore, the direction toward which your character is facing will always be at the top of the radar.

Often after you kill a monster, it will drop the items or adena it possessed. Move the cursor over the item or adena and it will change into a hand-like icon, allowing you to pick it up. Just click to pick it up. The items you have gathered can be viewed in the Inventory Window (Tab or Alt+V).

After killing a monster on the orders of an NPC, you will occasionally receive a quest item as proof. These items are not dropped to the ground, but you will hear a small sound and it will automatically be entered into the quest section of your Inventory Window. Look at your quest items by clicking on the Quest tab in the Inventory Window (Tab or Alt+V). To see the list of quests you are currently working on or quest items, click the Quest Information button in the lower right hand corner of the screen and then select the Quest tab (ALT+U).

You can bring up and view the Lineage II World Map by pressing the Mini Map button located in the lower right hand corner of the screen (Alt+M). For new players, the location of the Lineage II New Player Guide is indicated on the Map. If you click and drag the Map you are currently viewing, you can look up Maps for other locations as well.

If you press the "Current Loc." button, a Map of your surrounding area will be displayed with a mark indicating your current location. Also, if the "Location" function is currently activated in the Quest window, just press the "Target Loc." button, and a Map for your destination and a mark indicating your destination will be displayed as well.

Villages are indicated by "+" symbols on the Map. If you press one of these buttons, the applicable village's detailed Map will be displayed. While in the village Map, if you press the "-" button, you will be moved back to the global Map.

When a character of level 5 or above dies, some of its experience score (Exp) will be reduced and sometimes, with the exception of the weapons the character is currently equipped with, other items can be dropped.

In addition, if a character whose karma is 0 (you can check the karma value in the Status Windows, Alt+T) or if a character with 5 PK or less is killed during the battle (PVP) with another character, he or she will not drop any item.

Come on in! What are you looking for? We have many fine items, so take a look around. Remember, it always pays to buy the best armor and weapons possible -- your battles will become so much easier.

Uncle Sabrin says that the best life is to be prosperous in business, but I don't think so. A man should make his mark in the world. I'm stuck here selling wares, but I'm getting out soon. I'm going to the capital of Aden, where there are large castles and impressive buildings, to pursue my dreams.
The guards of this village must be blind -- letting someone like you just walk around ... Come back when you have purified your body and soul.

Look here, I've had my days in the dark shadows, like you. But look, now I'm in the light and living an honest life. Why don't you stop your wandering and come out into the bright world? I am truly sorry, but I will not trade with you now. But come and seek me out later.

Welcome, friend. This house trades diverse weapons with the greatest importance among the small tools used on the battlefield. We have various things from sharp bronze daggers to the finest mithril swords. Have a look.
Ha, look at me, getting all teary-eyed in front of a customer! Pardon me. All of my fine products are crafted here at the Ivory Tower.
Courtesy is our motto, but we cannot accept customers like you. Good day to you.
Greetings. Our shop specializes in handling dyes. Isn't the power of dyes amazing? No matter how excellent an adventurer is, he or she may need what our shop sells. So, why don't you take a look?

Welcome to the general store, run by the famous brother and sister team. You won t be disappointed, take a look. Our shop makes items in cooperation with the Ivory Tower, famous for magic, as well as the Dwarven guild "Breath of Flame". Actually, my sibling is a bit of a chatterbox... it is a good thing you've come to me.
No matter how bad sales are, I cannot sell to the likes of you. Please leave.

Welcome. Did you come here to embark on a boat trip? Gludin is going to have many passenger liners now. Can you believe it? A regular passenger liner from Elmore Kingdom which once was our our enemy...! Although you can't feel the passion or liveliness of the past here, I am hopeful that now I see that some things seem to be getting better.

Ahem, my name is Shari. They say it's not an appropriate name for a girl, but I'm proud of it. I was an orphan, but I'm pretty successful now, having my own shop. When I first started working for this store, many people were jealous of my talent. But I won them over with my personality, and they all like me now.
But, sweetie, do you know what you've gotten yourself into? You better go away before I get very upset!

Are you looking for something in particular? If you need anything, tell me. There is nothing that Jakal can't find, for he is utterly committed to your satisfaction! You should be well prepared to venture out. When you're not prepared, you can easily fail! But, of course, there is no way our noble Orcs could ever be harmed by the wild animals out there. Ha ha ha!!

I am Trader Uska! Nice to meet you, ha ha ha! I like getting to the point. I will ask you a short question. Is there anything you need? So, have a look around! Orcs should not waste time, even a few seconds! We should not neglect our training ... Keep this in mind!

Hoo hoo ... You are a lawbreaker. What a peaceful world! You are walking around as if nothing ever happened ... you, Great Lawbreaker! You better leave before I fetch my weapon! I don't know what I will end up doing to you! Hoo hoo!
I'm done talking with you. Get out of my store. Outward appearances mean little to me, its what is on the inside that is important. You come up short in that department. Leave!

Greetings, sir! Is there anything in particular you are looking for? Earrings, necklaces, rings and so forth... We have a wide selection of jewelry and accessories. Although we are located near the border with Elmore, the wealth of our city is most apparent here. We people of Aden people keep our elegant appearance no matter how dire the situation, wouldn't you agree? Well, take your pick. We have something for every budget!
I knew it! You're a known criminal, wanted for murder! I will not sell a ticket to someone like you! I could be putting the passengers' lives in jeopardy!

Welcome, traveler. We stock magic-related items and all sorts of general merchandise. Our customers are not only Wizards and Mystics but also Warriors looking for protection against magic attack and young ladies looking for pretty accessories... We have a very diverse and large clientele. Occasionally we get unwelcome customers who flip through spellbooks, looking for a clue to find Othellot's Sword. They seem to think my store is their private library!

Innadril has come through many bloody wars relatively unscathed. Lionel Hunter was a very good leader, skilled in both diplomatic and military matters. Under his rule Innadril's wealth began to rival that of Giran. But that was then and this is now. Chaos swirls around us and no one knows where we will end up!

I have long swords, daggers, light armor, heavy armor... If you want it, I've got it! Lowest prices in Giran! Come on, check it out! Hey there! What are you looking for? Hey there, adventurer. Why don't you at least come and take a look! I will surely give you a good price! Huh?
Hi there! Come on in! We have everything you need in our store! From sturdy iron armor to beautiful robes! We carry everything! Look around!
Oh, that man over there? He's my father, a man of great strength. He still carries heavy merchandise with his own hands. He doesn't trust young people nowadays...
How dare you show up here after committing a crime! I refuse to deal with the likes of you! Go away!
Just because we live in chaotic times, did you think that you would be treated any better? You fool! I don't want anything to do with you! Leave!
Who the hell do you think you are? I only cater to serious buyers! You'd better leave before the guards get here!

Ah, lately the old memories seem to be flooding back. Long ago, you know, this wharf was a beehive of activity! Trade ships of the Kresnik dropped anchor every day, filled to the gunwales with all sorts of wonderful items. Giran to the south -- even Heine -- were nothing by comparison.
Welcome! Ferocious animals are raised here! If you're lucky, you'll find that your animals obey you. If not... You'd be better off killing them before they kill you.
Welcome, seeker of wisdom, in the name of the gods! We sell spellbooks written by the magisters and priests themselves! Care to take a look?
May the starlight of the night bless you!
Oh seeker of truth! May the sacred light of Einhasad be with you always...

No matter the chaos that swirls around, a fragrant breeze and sunlight still warm the heart... What brings you here? If you're looking for a spellbook, I can help you. If you want to learn magic, find a priest or magister in the temple.
Welcome to Heine, traveler! In our temple, we sell spellbooks written by our priests in order to help the poor. Would you like to take a look?

Have you seen this temple's spire? Its proportion and balance are absolutely perfect! Isn't it beautiful? Legend says that it took several decades for the Dwarven artisans of Schuttgart to build it, and the elegant decorations were hand-made by Elves.

Hmm... if a foreign substance mixes with the fuel flowing at a steady rate in the internal pipes of a golem, the foreign substance will flow at a speed equal to the material that preceeds it. Resistance and dynamic power are applied to the fuel pipe...

No matter which blacksmith shop you visit in this kingdom, they'll all claim that their minerals are of the highest quality. Ha! That's ludicrous! What good is mass production if the same identically processed minerals have different qualities?
... At least once a day, clean the golem kettle! Get up early and paint the wheels with white Varnish! Three stones of purity a day should do it...

Suddenly we started to receive very large orders for weapons from the Aden guards! I'm sure there's a siege war coming! That's awesome! Weapons manufacturing causes the demand for minerals to skyrocket! You'd better buy some now before the price goes up!

Welcome to Hunters Village! Isn't it wonderful? We Dwarves live in the north part of town, and most of us are in the mining business. But we're certainly not averse to beautiful scenery and wondrous living creatures! The beauty of this place is reflected in the wide variety of minerals found here. Life couldn't get any better than this!
Welcome! That's quite a tan you have there, stranger! Oh, I hate to see adventurers getting scorched by the blazing sun, without any accessories would certainly improve your image!

You're looking for quality merchandise, am I right?! Well, you've come to the right place! Don't believe what you hear about that new shop owned by the Human female! Everyone says she has the best items, but it's all a bunch of hype! I'm a well-seasoned businessman, and you're better off here!

I don't mean to brag, but I'm a fourth-generation miner! I have the same name as my ancestor, "Mineral King Hitchi". People from far and wide would come to Schuttgart for his merchandise! Who knows? Maybe someday I'll be as rich as he was!
You're a jumpy little frizbat, aren't you?! You'll be off the edge before long, no doubt! I'll wager I have just the thing for your overzealousness!
I don't know if you know this, but this wharf was once so ridiculously shabby it couldn't even be properly called a wharf! Compared to then, it's a heck of a lot better now.

From time to time, those horrifying dinosaurs would even charge down from the jungle to devour the settlers. Now you see me as an old wharf manager, but back then I was just a hot-blooded young adventurer like you spoiling for a fight! Some days I was ready to tear into them with my bare hands. Of course, then I saw what they could do to the unskilled... Ah, but I still miss the days of my youth.

This is Giran Harbor through which all goods going to or coming from Giran must pass. Even we gatekeepers cannot magically teleport large packages. If that were so, what happened earlier... No, no. Just a fantasy...

I pray one day that your heart will once again be light and carefree in this beautiful city...

Merely brandishing your weapon will not increase your strength. Only when you learn new skills and use them appropriately will you be reborn as a true warrior. I will teach you all the skills that I know, and in return I expect your full attention.

Greetings. Possessing the right skills is just as important as possessing the weapon itself, especially in battle. Like you, I used to go to strong Masters and train myself endlessly. What do you want to learn from me?

I'm Magister Baulro, and I'm in charge of teaching magic here. All magical power emanates from nature, and from Einhasad, god of light. Therefore, magic is borrowed from the god and from nature. It cannot be performed only with one's power. Are you here to learn the ways of magic?

Nice to meet you. Forgive me if I am a little messy. An experiment I was working on last night met a little snag, and I haven't been able to deal with the mess yet. Anyway, you have come to me for help, have you not? Please tell me what you want me to do?

Ah, I made a slip of the tongue! Priest Petron is actually my elder twin brother. Unlike me, he is always calm and quiet. Ah, you asked what the Twins Temple means, didn't you? Well, here Yohanes and Baulro are twins, and so are Potter and I. It may be a coincidence, but the village people joke that the temple is the Twins Temple.
There is nothing I can teach you. Look for a guild that better suits you.

A wise person should be able to be generous to others. True generosity comes from the heart, when one has attained control over one's passions. Seek always to master your own spirit. Strength and skills will display their true meaning only when they come from the heart.

Magic is not slight of hand. It is a profound philosophy, a deep art. Since you have already taken another path, it would be too much for you to understand the meaning of magic. Go to your own Master.

Have you been to the ball that is held every fortnight at Giran Castle? If you have the time, you should by all means attend. The movement and rhythm of the dance is very similar to the swordsmanship of the Elven race.
Although I cannot move freely because of my wound, I could win with only my left hand ,even if three or four of you tried to attack me. You don't believe me? Then shall we test your skills?
Welcome, friend of magic. The potent magic of the Ivory Tower, which I teach, is entirely different from the spells of uncivilized Orcs, or the servile magic of the Elves, who flatter the spirits.
Greetings, kin of the forest. May Eva's blessing lighten the path in your worldly travels.

I see you are from a country school. Perhaps you studied at Einhovant's School of Wizardry? I wonder if you really learned the basics in such a remote place... I'm a little worried that you may not be able to keep up with my teaching.
I have nothing to teach you. You must find another teacher, someone who suits you better. Or perhaps you would prefer to stay and chat with me a bit longer?
Is there something you want to learn from me? I only teach Dark Elven Fighters as a rule. Of course I do make exceptions. It doesn't matter?
I am familiar with the plight of these farmers.

This is a village of poor farmers, who sought escape from the Lord's tyranny and, subsequently, does not have organized protection with proper guards. I formed the militia as I could not see the farmers fighting adequately against thieves and have other races plunder them helplessly.

No one has more knowledge about the skills of Orc Fighters than I do. But that would do you little good, of course ...

Behold the mutterings of a foolish old Mystic, pontificating forward with his delusions of grandeur..
No matter how vividly they are described to you, the brutal truths of battle cannot be understood without first-hand experience.
I couldn't care less whether you believe this or not. Battle ultimately comes down to a contest of wits, and you have just been defeated.
The ferocious beasts of the field understand the essence of battle, the inexorable urge to triumph over one's foe. Peace, however fleeting, has made our civilized races forget this primal emotion.
I cannot teach you. I only teach Orcs that have chosen the bloody path of endless battle.

It is good to see you! I must tell you that Innadril is much more dangerous than it appears. Of all the islands around Innadril, not one of them is safe. The Field of Reeds is a nest of thieves, anything shiny will be stolen... Heine is no better.

Elves have lived in Innadril since ancient days. Since around DE.1200, when Tetrach Terestien and his followers came here from Oren, they have been known as the "fairies of the lake". In those days, Humans and Elves intermarried freely. Elves blood flows through the veins of many residents of Innadril and therefore, the Humans in this area tend to live longer and be more attractive than elsewhere.

In Innadril there are more worshippers of Eva than of Einhasad. Accordingly, the temple of Eva is the much more magnificent of the two... Eva's followers in Innadril seem to have a slightly differnt view or their goddess than is widely accepted. This is no doubt due to the influence of the indigenous religions. It can be quite a shock to an unaccustomed Elf...

Hmmm, well, it's not that I'm lazy, you see... I simply cannot teach you magic. I am Human and I feel a little uncomfortable teaching something so sensitive to another race... And besides, you're not even a Mystic!

This place is too precious by half! It makes me want to puke! Those idiotic Elves, scrawling silly platitudes on every available bit of wall space! When the wars started this civilization began to crumble... The younger Dark Elves don't know any better, but for someone of my years of experience, the current climate is appalling!

I will never understand such behavior from Warriors! It is as though every might is New Year's Eve around here... It doesn't take a prophet to see that all this merriment cannot last forever! Could it be that no one sees this but me, or do they will be forced onto the battlefield completely unprepared!

I especially miss the Elven forest on days like this... It seems like only yesterday that I left the shadow of the Mother Tree and settled in this strange place, so far from my home... How quickly the years have passed!
Honestly, this temple is too formal and austere for me. I only come here so I can focus on my studies without getting distracted...
This place reminds me of something lost long ago... Something too easily forgotten...
