Welcome to the warm bosom of Einhasad, the goddess of light. What event has brought you to me? By the holy name of Einhasad, I pray I am able to help you!
Welcome! I am Grand Master Hannavalt, the leader of this Warriors Guild. Any warrior committed to the pursuit of physical and mental power are welcome here.
Pleased to meet you. I am High Priest Maximilian of this temple, may Einhasad's light comfort your soul's distress. Why have you come here, to the heart of our faith?

From ancient times, the Elves of Light have lived in harmony with the forest under the protection of the Mother Tree. Surrounded by her magic force field, this became their sanctuary from the outside world for a long, long time. However, the Sea of Spores east of the forest has been gradually expanding, and the dark brothers of the North and the Human kingdom of the South are looking for any excuse to take over our forest! Many of our young brothers feel that we cannot survive if we stay isolated in this forest in times like these, and they've started leaving for the outside world.
Welcome! I am High Priest Hollint of this temple. Why have you come here, where Einhasad of the light is served? Do you perhaps wish to embark on the difficult path of a Priest?

May Einhasad's blessing be upon you... O brother, what has led you into the power of this divine light? What business has brought you to me? I will gladly help you if by doing so Einhasad's light might be further spread through this darkened world.

The Holy War of Darkness to punish the deceitful Humans and the evil Elves of light who despised and persecuted us continues. Our revenge is not complete! We who lived in darkness for so long can understand more than anyone the truth in the shadows. The day will come when the true power contained in darkness will triumph decisively! We'll dominate the entire continent! This is our destiny.
May Shilen's power shade you from the harshness of the light!

On behalf of the Hierarch, who was sealed by those despicable servants of the light, I represent the senior council that governs the race of darkness. It was I, Tetrarch Thifiell -- chosen by Gran Kain, the father of shadow, and Shilen, the mother of the abyss -- who led our brothers out of their underground exile and recaptured the Forest of Shadow from those moon-faced Elves of light! You, child of Shilen! What is it that you wish to know?

Hey there, traveler! Pleased to meet you; I am Warehouse Chief Moke of the Iron Gate Guild here in Gludin. You've heard our motto, right? "Sell anything to anyone, anywhere." We'll travel to frozen wastes, burning deserts, even the dangerous volcanic zones of the north, for the sake of plying our trade. Ha! Who can match that? Tell me, my friend, have you come here in order to become a member of our guild?

I, High Prefect Osborn, teach Orcs by the authority of Pa'agrio, the father of eternal fire. It is my duty to help ensure that we may once more attain the glory of our illustrious ancestors. You, young Orc warrior, you are like a tinderbox whose spark, though small, becomes a great blaze! In you I see the hope that will revive the trampled pride of our Orc tribe. How may I be of service to you?

Hey there, traveler! Pleased to meet you; I am Warehouse Chief Rikadio of the Iron Gate Guild here in Gludin. You've heard our motto, right? "Sell anything to anyone, anywhere." We'll travel to frozen wastes, burning deserts, even the dangerous volcanic zones of the north, for the sake of plying our trade. Ha! Who can match that? Tell me, my friend, have you come here in order to become a member of our guild?

I, High Prefect Drikus, teach Orcs by the authority of Pa'agrio, the father of eternal fire. It is my duty to help ensure that we may once more attain the glory of our illustrious ancestors. You, young Orc warrior, you are like a tinderbox whose spark, though small, becomes a great blaze! In you I see the hope that will revive the trampled pride of our Orc tribe. How may I be of service to you?

I, High Prefect Cional, teach Orcs by the authority of Pa'agrio, the father of eternal fire. It is my duty to help ensure that we may once more attain the glory of our illustrious ancestors. You, young Orc warrior, you are like a tinderbox whose spark, though small, becomes a great blaze! In you I see the hope that will revive the trampled pride of our Orc tribe. How may I be of service to you?

I am Warehouse Chief Gesto of the Iron Gate Guild here in Giran. Our motto is "We sell anything to anyone, anywhere." We travel to frozen wastes, deserts, even volcanic zones, to create prosperity for our Dwarven tribe. Who else can claim that?

I'm Warehouse Chief Ranspo of the Iron Gate Guild here in Gludin. Our motto is "Sell anything to anyone, anywhere." We'll travel to frozen wastes, burning deserts, even fiery volcanic zones, in order to sell our wares and create prosperity for our Dwarven tribe. Ha! Who else can say half as much?

I am Head Blacksmith Flutter of the Black Anvil Guild here in the Town of Oren. Can I be of service to you? Hmm... It's been a busy season here already, what with all these Artisans coming over for a class transfer to Warsmith.

I'm Head Blacksmith Vergara of the Black Anvil Guild here in Hunter Village. It's my job to take qualified Artisans and transform them into talented Warsmiths. If you want to make money, there's nothing better than being a Warsmith. Interested?

Keuk! Oh, my aching head... It must be true what they say about those thrice-cursed wine merchants spiking their Dreviant wine with spider venom! Fiends! Hellspawn! Tax collectors! An eternity of torment would be too good for them... And Cedric here must have drunk three bottles by himslef, that old Dwarvish geezer! What are laughing at, Desmo? You're no better! Drunkards, the lot of you! Where's the hot tea?

But true holiness can always be found in the ordinary, the everyday, the mundane. The prayer of a commoner may resonate more deeply with the mother of light than even the prayer of a high priest, so perhaps this place is not so different from other temples.

Welcome, traveler. May the goddess of light's providence be always with you. I am Squillari, a servant of Einhasad, who lives to help fulfill the will of the goddess of light in this land of water. Traveler, it would be a blessing if I could help you in your search for instruction.

Heine, the city of water... Fools with stars in their eyes seem to have forgotten that before there was Eva, there was Shilen... The Goddess of Dark Water still slumbers without sleeping, deep down in the abyss of the sea...
What motto should we use this month...? We need something that will attract customers like sugar attracts ants... Hmm? Your face just gave me a great idea!
Same with life -- no matter how much sorrow or turmoil you may face, if you can endure it, you will become as strong and resilient as tempered steel!
And we, the apostles of light, must provide guidance and wisdom...
Heh, I understand why a man like Scraide might have settled here... Was it the battles against the Orcs that changed him, do you think, or was that always his nature?

Those disgusting Varka Silenos and Ketra Orc tribes intend to battle nearby, and it is said that the Fire Dragon Valakas has awakened from its long slumber. Soon it will be time for Pa'agrio's glorious warriors to arise, so do not be relax with your preparations!

What do you think, young one? As a training opportunity, would you care to match your skills against those of the masters of this place? Although their teaching style is a little rough, I can promise it is very effective.
Worried about getting hurt during training? Ah! A Magister can be quickly called from the library over there to cast a cure spell, should that be necessary.

Even though we have the reputation as the top Warrior training camp in the entire kingdom, I, High Prefect Lambac, am almost mad with frustration at having to train with these fragile Humans and Elves! If I exert even a little strength, their bones snap like twigs, or they swoon like a lovesick girl...

Do you know when the blacksmiths of Schuttgart Territory are the happiest? It's the moment we walk out of our shop and breathe in that cold fresh air after working long hours surrounded by scorching heat and banging noise. That moment feels like heaven!
Actually, Schuttgart is not yet recognized as a place where warriors can hone their abilities, so Grand Masters like myself have had a difficult time developing our own skills.
How long will the peace in Schuttgart last?

It is not exaggerating much to say that the peace is primarily kept thanks to the freezing weather and rugged terrain. However, the whole area is now infested with bandits. Our peaceful lifestyle is like sweet honey, but unless we take precautions, we may all soon come to taste only bitterness.
I'd rather not think about this and that. Can't you just take care of it on your own? You're younger and smarter than I am, so I'm sure you know better...
My Orc comrade! Are you ready to be reborn in blood and fire as a true warrior of our kind? Schuttgart Territory is necessary if our race is to regain our former glory.

How long must we suffer the disdain of those puny Dwarves and moon-faced Elves? Young Orc! Schuttgart may well become a key strategic position for the warriors of the Elmorean kingdom. If we Orcs unite, it will be a trivial matter to occupy this defenseless place. Stoke up your smoldering vengeance! The time to strike swift and hard will soon be at hand.
Pleased to met you. I am Grand Magister Javier. Ah, is my voice too loud? Sorry! Whenever I see young, promising warriors like you, my excitement just gets the better of me!
I am Warehouse Chief Alder of the Iron Gate Guild here in Schuttgart. Ah! I cannot abide the chaos I see racing through the world like a forest fire in summer.
Welcome! I am Head Blacksmith Bolin of the Black Anvil Guild here in Schuttgart. After I've finished with you, my lad, you'll be a living testimony to the guild's prowess and prestige.

Let the other races brag about their armies; we know how idle their boasts really are. How would they wage battle or lay siege to fortresses without the siege golems, weapons and armor that we create? Even their greatest warriors would be as helpless as newborn babes without our labors.

Pa'agrio Tejakar! Welcome! I am High Prefect Finker, and I teach Orcs by the authority of Pa'agrio, the father of eternal fire, that we may once more attain the lost glory of our ancestors of old. My mission is to transform talented Orcs like you, my young friend, into strong and steely Orc warriors feared by all races. Do you wish to be reborn as a powerful Orc warrior?
Ye who are laden with heavy burdens, come to me. Welcome. Have you come to entrust your possessions?

Only fools and donkeys carry unnecessarily heavy loads. Now, why don't you entrust your items to our safe and inexpensive Iron Gate. I, Valkon, swear in the name of the Iron Gate to guard your property with my life, so go ahead and give it to me.

Unless you're a Dwarven peddler, why bother carrying such heavy items around? If you carry the items to deliver them to the other person, why don't you let me keep them? I will surely keep them until the person you designate comes.

Oh, welcome , welcome. Heavy eh? Put down your stuff...
This is a secure warehouse that is managed by the Dwarven bank union. Once you have deposited your items, I can give your items total security until the person who will take them comes. I mean, in all of history have you ever heard of a warehouse, managed by a Dwarf, being robbed? I bet you haven't?
You have the wrong man! I'm a warehouse keeper and a teacher of Dwarven Scavengers and Bounty Hunters. You may be a Dwarf, but you would be much better off being taught by a Blacksmith.

Aghhh ... really ... another lost person ... aghhh ... I'm so tired! You are at the Iron Gate. It seems like you have nothing to learn here! You better go somewhere else while I'm still in a good mood.
Hmmm... I think I did better this time...? Uncle Sorint! Did you hear that?
I've got much more important things to attend to than your education, got it? Let's get this over with. What's your profession? Dwarven Fighter?

Welcome to the Iron Gate Gulid of Heine, adventurer! Are you here to claim your cargo or to drop some off? Or perhaps you're here to learn new skills? I'm way too busy these days.... Really! Of course, it's mostly due to our guild's expansion, but...
We Treat The Customers' Assets As If They Were Our Own! That's our motto! No need to worry about the safety of your item when you deposit it with us!
Have you written down the recipient's name? Please verify it! If the name doesn't match, there is no way we can deliver it!

The seeds can be classified into regular type and alternative type. If you plant a regular type seed, a monster will hide an item and give you a crop of equivalent value instead.
When you plant alternative type seed, you will receive a crop approximately half of the time or you will receive an item approximately half of the time.
The lord of a manor can manage his manor according to the farmers' way of planting and the characteristics of the seed.
There are four kinds of seed--coda, cobol, codran and coba. Availability of each type is based upon a character's level. Coda is the seed most appropriate for farmers whose levels are between level 10 and level 30, relatively low levels. Cobol is the seed most appropriate for farmers whose levels fall between level 31 and level 48. Codran is the seed most appropriate for high level farmers of level 49 and level 64. Coba is the seed most appropriate for high level farmers of level 65 or above. First, you will need to clearly understand what type of people are being active in our manor so that you will know what type of seeds you should sell.
Needless to say, you will get different crops for different types of seeds. And since a seed will absorb the energy of a monster and grow instantly, in order to have a good crop, you have to plant seed onto an appropriate monster. If a monster is weak, he will produce a disappointing crop. On the other hand, if he is too strong, the crop could be damaged as well. One secret of a successful crop is to pick a monster with approximately the same power as the sower. Trying to sow a seed on a non-compliant monster can have disastrous consequences.
You may only buy a certain amount of seeds each day. The things that can be produced are largely divided into the things that are on the enchant scrolls and those that are not. Therefore, you should first decide on what kind of items you want to make and then grow the appropriate special crops for it. Of course you should also consider the financial state of the castle.
There is a fixed amount of seeds that can be sold each day. Any stock remaining unsold at the end of the day can be sold the next day.
New seed types go on sale each day at 8 p.m. If you don't tell me the type of seed, volume price etc. you want to sell, I will give an order to sell the seeds in the same way as the previous day.

When the territory's residents bring their crops, managers sent by the Lord buy them. When purchasing the crops, they must fairly compensate the residents. Considering the castle's financial status, they must determine the reward prices and Royal gifts to be given out as the reward. If the reward price and Royal gift are not fair, farmers will sell the indigenous products harvested in our castle to other castles that are purchasing for better conditions. Not all of them are doing so, but please keep it mind that there are other castles purchasing the same indigenous products that our castle does.
There are two price lists used for crops. One list contains items of similar value. The other list contains items of varying value, adding an element of luck to the process. Choice of list is based on preference of the people.
Each day from 8 p.m. until the next day at 6 a.m. you can adjust the purchase price and amount of crops needed. If a change of orders is not received during this time period, the previous day's orders will be in effect.
Funds for purchase will be released from the treasury each day, and un-spent funds are returned to the safe when the market closes.
Always remember! You can do this only when you have sufficient funds available in the safe of a castle to purchase crops. At 6 a.m. when the next manor changes, the funds required for the next manor is taken out of the safe. Please make sure that the appropriate amount must be in the safe of the castle before that time.

At 6 a.m., the amount required to purchase seeds or crops is taken out of the safe of our castle in advance.
If the balance is not enough at that time, the manor will have to stop for a whole day. Don't forget about this.
At 8 p.m., the remainder of the purchasing budget for the previous day is deposited back to the safe.

You cannot set the selling prices and reward prices of seeds and crops at 60% or lower or 1,000% or higher than the standard prices.
The volume setup is different for general seeds and alternative seeds.
Since the general seeds have a high harvesting rate, you can buy a little more than the seed sales volume of our castle. However, the procurement volume of the alternative seeds has to be smaller than the seed sales volume because the alternative seeds have a low harvesting rate. Please make a note of this.
Within this range, the lord must make judgments to set up the manor that satisfies all the farmers and lord.

However, the magic of light that the priests teach here cannot be taught to just anyone. Only Mystics of Human birth, and among them only those who seek divine truth, can receive lessons here.
The magic of light that the Gods have allowed us to share must be used to punish these dark powers. This is our destiny!

You have come to receive training from me? I'm afraid that what little knowledge of magic I have is only useful for holy Mystics of Human birth. I cannot teach you anything worthwhile. I feel that I owe you an apology.
Welcome, traveler from faraway lands. This place is Giran, the wealthiest region in the kingdom. There is no better place to replenish your weary mind and body.

To Mystics of other races, darkness is the substance of fear. They turn away from shadows and try to obtain strength only from the light. However, that is only half the truth. An incomplete understanding of magic is weak and worthless. I will teach you the ultimate power within dark, the secret of magical strength hidden in the shadows.

Oh my, a letter for me...? From Darin... Yes, of course I know him. I thought he had feelings for me and, actually, I like him too. I think he is a very fine person. Of course, there is that trifling matter of him being so timid...
Here, please give Darin my <font color="LEVEL">handkerchief</font>. And please deliver my message to our shy Darin that I will accept his affections with all my heart.
Have you given Darin my handkerchief? What did he say? I thought he would rush right over and ask permission to court me... He is so timid!
Of course, that is part of what makes him so attractive... For some reason, it brings out my maternal side.

Please deliver this to Darin now. Actually... don't tell him, but the contents of this bottle is plain water from the well in front of the temple. The talk about magic potions that have been handed down from generation to generation... well, those are stories that I made up to encourage Darin. This potion is no different from plain old water. I would appreciate it if you don't tell and just give this <font color="LEVEL">magic potion</font> to Darin.
Ask who Darin's love is
The woman who has stolen my heart and taught me what it feels like to fall in love is Roxxy. Do you know her? She's our village Gatekeeper.
Say that you do not know her
Say that you know Roxxy

What, you don't know her? How could you not know her? The fairest maiden in all of Talking Island... Plus, she is highly trained in magic and has studied at the Ivory Tower in Oren. She is also a member of the Gatekeepers Guild which manages the magic portals that connect the various villages together.

Such an accomplished lady... Would she even give me a chance? I often think of going and confessing my love to her, but... I just don't have the courage to do it. I mean, what if she refuses? It would kill me. It's been a week since I wrote a letter confessing my affections for her, but it still sits in my pocket...
Could you do me a favor? My letter... Would you deliver it to Roxxy?
Say you will do the favor

Ah, so you do know her. It's hard to find such a beauty as Roxxy, isn't it? A woman like her... Would she even give me a chance? I often think of going and confessing my love to her, but I just don't have the courage to do it. I mean, what if she refuses? It would kill me. It's been a week since I wrote a letter confessing my affections for her, but it still sits in my pocket, without being delivered...
Could you do me a favor? My letter... Would you deliver it to Roxxy?
Say you will do the favor
Please... give her this letter. Thank you!
You haven't been able to meet Roxxy yet? I am so nervous and anxious, waiting for her reply... I beg of you, please hurry. Please deliver my letter to Roxxy.

A while ago, I had a talk with Baulro from the temple regarding Roxxy, and he promised that he would create a magic potion for me that makes the user more eloquent, saying that it would be helpful when courting a woman. Something about being able to capture the person's heart through witty talk? It was a bit expensive, but I bought it thinking that I would need it to talk with Roxxy. Please take this receipt to <font color="LEVEL">Baulro</font> and tell him my situation, and he will give you the potion.
Your eyes are like the moonlight...
Ah! You haven't gotten the potion from Baulro yet? I'm writing a poem to recite to Roxxy when I ask her permission to court her. I have to hurry before the sun sets...
I must write a letter to Arujien to tell him that I appreciate his affection, but there is already someone else who has captured my heart...
I see that you haven't delivered my reply to Arujien yet. Just as you are hesitating now, it has been even more difficult for me to write a letter refusing his heart.

I don't have the courage to go and confess my feelings for her, so I am writing a letter. I guess I will have to ask someone to deliver this love letter to her. It would be nice if I could find someone trustworthy. For the honor of the lady that I love, I need someone who can keep a secret.

Before I tell you her name, you must promise me, for her honor's sake, that you will not utter her name lightly. It would be serious indeed if the lady's sacred honor is tainted in any way. Her name is Greenis, but everyone calls her 'Greens Well' because her smile is as clear as the spring waters of the green fields. She is the beautiful woman that has ensnared my soul. My heart flutters as I think of her again.

I don't want to be rude and commit such blunders as asking her directly. That is not an appropriate course of action towards a lady. However, she has a younger sister. I'm speaking of Gatekeeper Mirabel. Perhaps she will know what Greenis' mind is. Please show this letter to Mirabel without letting Greenis know, and tell Mirabel how desperate my heart is. And ask her if Greenis would ever accept my affections. I am entrusting you with this letter, so please discover the true heart of the woman I love.
Gatekeeper Mirabel may be young, but she is Greenis' sister and also a woman. I think she will know Greenis' heart well. Show her my letter, and please tell me her answer.

So Mirabel told you to go to Trader Herbiel? I knew that Herbiel is Greenis' uncle, but it's quite awkward for me to ask him about love and attraction. Well ... It's better to hear the opinions of more people ... right? Please go and show my letter to <font color="LEVEL">Herbiel</font>, and ask him about what Greenis thinks of me.

What did Herbiel say? Did he say that Greenis has feelings for me? Is she attracted to me as much as I am to her? Will she accept my heart? Will this love, that I have devoted my entire soul to, be fulfilled?

Ahh ... So Greenis has also been watching me. I have a <font color="LEVEL">poetry book</font> that I have been carrying around to give to her if she should accept my love ... Please deliver this to Greenis. This is quite embarrassing, but there are a few poems in the book that I have written myself. It would be better if you also tell her this.

So... This is the way it ends... There is nothing I can do. Perhaps it would have been better to just contain my love within my heart. I guess that even this pain is a part of love. It is heartbreaking, but I've learned a priceless lesson, that the greater the longing, the harder it is to love, and that is why it is ever so much more painful...
Here, take this... It's not much, but you've given me so much help in learning a little bit more about the pain of heartbreak, so please consider it a fee for my lesson and accept it.

So... This is the way it ends... There is nothing I can do. Perhaps it would have been better to just contain my love within my heart. I guess that even this pain is a part of love. It is heartbreaking, but I've learned a priceless lesson, that the greater the longing, the harder it is to love, and that is why it is ever so much more painful...
Here, take this... It's not much, but you've given me so much help in learning a little bit more about the pain of heartbreak, so please consider it a fee for my lesson and accept it.

As you know, the seal is composed of three levels -- the physical seal, that restrains the body, the mental seal that restrains his mind, and the spiritual seal that restrains his soul. This time, I am attempting to break that first seal, the physical seal. But to perform the magic, I need many rare materials. I'd like to ask you to go and gather them. I'm sure you won't refuse?
You haven't been able to gather all three materials yet? Don't tell me that you've forgotten what materials you need to gather?

Meet the representatives of each tribe and bring back their gifts! Don't tell me that you have forgotten what your task is?

This orb, brought out from the depths of the black seas of the west, is an object called a "pearl" by Humans! Those that carry this orb on their person gain the ability to see into the future. There is no better gift than this for the Pa'agrio Lord, leader of the Orcs!
Here you go: 1 sack of Boomboom Powder. Please don't drop it!
I gave you a sack of Boomboom Powder, right? Hurry and take it to Miner Bolter. And be sure not to get it near any open flame, or getting Bolter's reward will be the least of your worries!

Frankly, we prefer it out here, living among the rock and rubble of the mine instead of some stuffy cottage back in the village. The only drawback is that we still have to send someone into the village every few days to get supplies. It was Fundal's turn to go, but he broke his leg in a mining accident this morning. Do you know anyone trustworthy enough to go in his place?

Frankly, we prefer it out here, living among the rock and rubble of the mine instead of some stuffy cottage back in the village. The only drawback is that we still have to send someone into the village every few days to get supplies. It was Fundal's turn to go, but he broke his leg in a mining accident this morning. Will you go in his place?
I see you talked with Sir Collin Windawood! He's a great man, isn't he ? You should now speak back to Gatekeeper Roxxy.
Meet <font color="LEVEL">Gatekeeper Roxxy</font> and tell her I sent you. Good luck!
So where is Baulro's letter? Did you miss something?
Hurry up and bring me the letter!
Go to <font color="LEVEL">Gatekeeper Roxxy</font> and tell her I sent you. She'll help you. Giran is more hectic than you're used to, so be careful. Good luck!
Very few gatekeepers truly understand this world. I've visited countless cities and villages, but certainly can't say that I understand everyone who lives in them.
Very few gatekeepers truly understand this world. I've visited countless cities and villages, but certainly can't say that I understand everyone who lives in them.

Fortunately for you, <font color="LEVEL">Hierarch Asterios</font> is sponsoring young Elves who want to experience the outside world. I'll write you a letter of Recommendation. Take it with you when you go see him!
Do you have that Recommendation letter I wrote for you? Take it to <font color="LEVEL">Hierarch Asterios</font>, I'm sure he'll sponsor you!
When you're ready to go, speak with <font color="LEVEL">Gatekeeper Mirabel</font>. I'll ask her to help you.
I've spoken with Gatekeeper Mirabel, and she's agreed to help you.

I wasn't there for long, but I can tell you that it's a very dynamic, vibrant place. There are all sorts of people searching for adventure and romance there. The village is something of a world unto itself! You simply must visit it sometime...
Don't you have anything better to do?
"Gatekeeper Jasmine told me..."
Tell Gatekeeper Tamil I sent you, she'll help you from there.
Find <font color="LEVEL">Gatekeeper Tamil</font>, she'll give you the directions.

Of course, dragons are quite formidable! But there is a beast who can subjugate even the mightiest of dragons! They are called Humans. We creatures of Pa'agrio are fammiliar with this scourage... It was they who defeated us in battle and exiled us to this Immortal Plateau!

Try to find out from him who is getting the right to strip mine mithril. I certainly won't blame you if you can't get this information. It's a very sensitive matter. I hope you don't mind me asking this of you...
Damn that Reed! He knows better than that...

You again, huh?! Although I'll consider the right to strip mine more in the future, tell whoever sent this gift that he has a slight chance to strip mine the mithril this time. Bring me more gifts when you can.

As you know, the Ketra Orcs are the most daring and ferocious tribe. They never lag behind in terms of body structure or strength. So those who are weak run away at the sight of those orcs, causing me a great deal of trouble. But since Cadmon sent you here and you seem to possess great skills, I guess I don't have to worry about that. The task is simple. Take this box of supplies to the Ketra Orc outpost and deliver them to Messenger Wahkan. It won't be difficult to find Wahkan since he's staying in the base center. Although it may be a little difficult to enter the base...

Bear in mind that the Varka Silenos are different from other Silenos. They may look alike, but the Varka Silenos have traditionally been fearless soldiers. They are completely different from other Silenos who are engaged in stock farming. They are very particular about manners. You should try not to offend them.
Did Fundin send you? A little late, but at least you didn't break it.
Could you deliver her last letter to him?
My friend left to study archaeology at the Imperial Tomb a few years ago. I have a letter for him, but I think you aren't capable enough to handle this delivery yet.
He may be hard to find, but his last letter mentioned the <font color="LEVEL">Imperial Tomb</font>. Maybe you can find him there!
Huh? You were asked to give me this letter? Who writes a letter to a dead person? Hmm...Let me see...
Thank you for bringing the letter to me. Please accept this token of my appreciation.
The world is very unsettled these days. Would you be interested in a unique kind of power?
Ah! You're looking for the elder too, aren't you? Lots of folks looking for him these days... This is getting old! Do I look like a street sign to you?
The seal is loosening! The power is getting stronger.
Sprinkle the Blood of Saint.
The Blood of Saint you sprinkled on the Altar of Saints quickly disappeared. You're starting to feel better now. It's time to move on!
Sprinkle the Blood of Saint.
The Altar of Saints reacts to the Blood of Saint. You're starting to feel better. The altar appears depleted. It's time to move on.
Sprinkle the Blood of Saint.
Sprinkle the Blood of Saint.
The Altar of Saints is behaving strangely. This is getting tiresome. It seems that I'm changed a lot. Time to go back and see the elder.
"What do you need done?"
Before I tell you, I need to ask you something. How strong is your faith in the work that we do? Are you certain that you can persevere no matter what happens while carrying out this mission?
Uncle Donal sent you? Here's the box! Heavy, isn't it? Deliver it quickly before the winter comes!
Hey, ale and mutton pie! You want a drink? What do you think of mercenary life? We're recruiting!
Excuse me. Can you help me for a little while? I ordered some meat, but they sent me low-quality meat instead of what I ordered! Would you go and return this for me?
You? Fine! Here is the meat! This is the kind of meat that rotten Pasture Manager Tunatun sent me!
Man, the more I think about it, the angrier I get! No matter what he says, tell him that I don't care! I'm never going to do business with him again!
You? Can you choose top-quality meat? Or can you strike a bargain with that rotten manager?
Well, there's nothing I can do. I'll apologize to him later. For now, please take this money. At least he'll have gotten a refund when I go to talk to him later.
Aaah... Pastoral scenes like this make me wish I could see these cute little critters grow up!
Aaah... Pastoral scenes like this make me wish I could see these cute lttle critters grow up!
Alas, this is an honor that only comes once in a lifetime... I'll never forget my little beast... And the brilliance of that gemstone!
I was so young! So full of hopes and dreams... all but forgotten now...

The padlock is engraved with the mark of the Hellmann family. In spite of it's many years outside, once the outer layer of dust and soil is brushed away, it shines silvery in the light! This lock won't be easy to break.
You feel the cold metallic surface of the Einhasad's Crucifix. Since it's been inside the bookshelf for a long time, it's a little rusty.

_page.broadcastSay(ChatType.GENERAL, "My master has instructed me to be your guide, " + player.getName() + ".");
It was the very same crucifix I gave you! Did you drop it?
You'll find the well in the northwest part of the village. Show the ghost the letter and he'll grant your request.
Take the letter to him and come back to me with his reply.
I must open it carefully and see what it holds. Why don't you come back a little later?
It seemed the battle was over, until..."
I'm afraid it won't be easy, and you look very tired! Why don't you take a break and come back later when you're refreshed and have had a little more training.

Unbelievable! Whose soul could the high priest want me to summon with dark magic? Doesn't he serve the god of light?
A spirit attacks you from the well.

The Hellmann family had revolted against the kingdom, hoping that the King would fight. However, the King had lost his will to fight since losing his wife and son at the battle against Amadeo, King of Aden.
"Here's a letter from the High Priest of the Earth."
The heads of those accused of following demons were thrown into it. If you enter the well, they'll attack you!
They aren't very smart! They'll attack if you touch the well.

"Lidia was bitten by a vampire."
"As I said before, Lidia was bitten by a vampire! Don't you get it?"

The moment the words leave your lips, you feel an electric current shoot through your head, buzzing like 5000 wyverns in flight! Deep within your heart wells an emotion, small but growing more intense by the moment...
This concerns Lidia's Diary? Is that right? Oh, I see! Dear traveler! For whatever little time I have left, I'll read this diary and go over the past again and again in my mind!
The hairpin is a type once used by aristocratic ladies. It's engraved with the image of a Moon Face Flower, and was probably used by a unattached young lady.

Why, she's Lady Lidia, current lord of this manor! She thought highly of Rose, and didn't want her coming back as an undead! Lady Lidia graciously allowed Rose to rest in peace. That's better than most others get around here!
Recently my nights have been dreamless, and I've woken up with wounds that I don't remember getting! Something strange is going on in this village! Will you investigate?
So, you haven't met the maid of our lord yet? Remember, she only appears at night. Naturally, things get pretty scary around here after dark... You should really be careful!
Oh, come in! Say, you must've dropped this the last time you were here! It looks very valuable! You should keep it in a safe place.
Oh, that. It's an amulet to help my puppets collect bone pieces in the forest without getting hurt.
It may look a little odd, but it's just an amulet.
This doll was made by Nidrah, and tells the Lord of the Forest of the Dead not to attack its bearer.
Come back after reading this letter from my lady.
I don't know what it says, I wouldn't dream of reading the letter meant for my lord!
Oh no! Could you have dropped it in the village? Take the letter with you and ask around for it. Meet me again tomorrow night.
registerQuestItems(FLOWER, SILVER_CROSS, BROKEN_SILVER_CROSS, LETTER, HAIRPIN, TOTEM);
You'd still better not use it yourself if you can help it.
Don't be angry with me! No matter how much power a Mystic possesses, he can't fight the great powers that move this world.
It's time for me to attend the worship service for Einhasad, the great god of light!
Anyway, it doesn't matter whether or not I'm him.
I separated her personality into two bodies, and figured the stronger would prey on the weaker. Well, it turned out a little different.

Some say it's the revolutionary army of dusk, but I don't care about such things. I'm interested in knowledge, not power and exploitation.
If you're still angry, go to the temple of the Rune Township. Perhaps the holy relic...I mean the doll will help shed light on things.
And on the day of the tragedy of Hellmann Forest... Rose, the maid of Lidia, wore it to divert attention from Lidia.
The dress deceived the attackers. Rose sacrificed herself for Lidia.
I am Lidia von Hellmann! I must have written the diary and the letter I gave you. My memory is incomplete and is being controlled by Hardin.

Recently, I completed a really great golem bluprint, but I accidently dropped it off of the bridge and lost it! What a terrible loss!

I think this is the <font color="LEVEL">large blue treasure box</font> that my client lost. It seems to contain a blueprint of golem. The only blacksmith in this whole area capable of making such a thing is Shaling in this village. She told me recently that she had dropped a box containing a blueprint in the river while she was traveling. This must be it! Please take this blueprint of golem to Shaling in the Blacksmith Shop.
She told me recently that she had dropped a box containing a blueprint in the river while she was traveling. So deliver it quickly!
"I have a letter for you."
A letter for me? You must be mistaken. Dwarves never lose anything! You must have misunderstood.
This seems to be the large yellow treasure box that my client lost! When I opened it, it contained a letter addressed to Miss Kiki.

I apologize for being untruthful earlier. The bait works better if the fisherman doesn't know about its properties. Bring me the <font color="LEVEL">small purple treasure box</font> and I'll tell you who it belongs to! He lost it near the shore. Look for it there. Remember, your fishing skill must be level 16, and you must bring the box to me unopened. Someone else may have already found it, so ask around in the market.

You say you've found the musical score I'm looking for, but you don't seem to have it with you. If you find a musical score with the name "Rukal" written on it, please bring it to me. It was composed by my late father.
Krorin's diary tells of four ancient monuments scattered in the swamp.
Please take this as a small token of my thanks, I'd have something better for you if I weren't stuck in this swamp!
Much cleaner and better preserved than the previous monuments. It's covered in strange hieroglyphs and diagrams.

The Map seems to indicate that the monuments in this area were built to track the moon. The four monuments indicate the positions of the moon on the fall and spring equinoxes, and the summer and winter solstices. There are no more forgotten monuments in this area.

When you open the backpack that is still on the corpse, you find a waterproof lambskin-covered book. Various memos are written in it, and on one page you find a sloppily drawn Map that seems to be of the Swamp of Screams. Could this be the log mentioned by Mercenary Supplier Abercrombie?
addTalkId(ABERCROMBIE, CORPSE_OF_DWARF, FORGOTTEN_MONUMENT_1, FORGOTTEN_MONUMENT_2, FORGOTTEN_MONUMENT_3, FORGOTTEN_MONUMENT_4);
Ah yes, I'd love to fulfill the high priest's request, but I don't think I can make that medicine. I sent Miki the Cat looking for Moretti's herbs, but I lost contact with him.

He did send me the map! Meow~! Thank you for delivering it. I don't have any Moretti's herb for him, I lost it while wandering around. I'll tell you where to get some, though. Will you get it for me? I'm sure Gentler will give you a proper reward. You can get them from <font color="LEVEL">alligators on Alligator Island</font>. They eat the herbs for digestion. Hunt alligators, get 20 herbs and go straight to Gentler when you're done.
So, Mr. Woodley sent you? Where is his payment? Did you drop it by any chance? Please check your pockets!

Welcome! Radia told me you'd be coming. Are you here for the spidersilk, thread and suede? Sorry, we're all out! You can probably get some thread and suede from travelers, but as for the spidersilk, that's another matter! I can make some for you if you help me!
Ah, you mean Radia's order? Well, I haven't gotten the materials yet. The goods she wants have been rather scarce of late, making them difficult to obtain.
"Where can I find Mr. Felton?"
With this Oriharukon and silver, I'll make a very pretty... Oh no!
Here are the materials.
You still haven't brought everything I need! I know it's hard work, but you're in a much better position to get it than I am!
I'm sorry, but you must grow a little before you can wear Formal Wear.

Have you forgotten whom you need to visit? Pick up a <font color="LEVEL">Sewing kit</font> from <font color="LEVEL">Blacksmith Ferris of Aden Castle Town</font>, <font color="LEVEL">gemstones</font> from <font color="LEVEL">Jeweler Ellie of Giran Castle Town</font> and the <font color="LEVEL">fabric</font> from <font color="LEVEL">Radia of Giran Castle Town</font>. Hurry back!

Did you go see Mr. Woodley? Without the shoes, no matter how pretty the Formal Wear I make is, it will be totally useless. Go to <font color="LEVEL">Trader Woodley</font> and ask him to make you a pair of shoes. Hurry!

I just got an order for a cool bottle of wine from <font color="LEVEL">Information Broker Mist</font> at the hot springs resort. If you'll take it to him, i'll bake some cookies for you. Is that a deal or what? Hurry! I'll have some fresh, hot cookies waiting for you!
Haven't you left yet? You'd better get that cool wine to <font color="LEVEL">Information Broker Mist</font> right away!

Well, we've obviously got to deal with this thing. Hopefully it's not too late... But what ever shall we do? Its power is growing by the moment!... I'll bet Magister Rohmer of Gludio Castle knows what we should do.... But I can't just drop everything and run to him...

Please take this letter to Magister Rohmer in the Temple of Einhasad in the Town of Gludio. Bring me his reply as soon as possible. You can find him if you follow the road in a northeast from here. Miss Richlin can get you there faster through the gate of time and space.
This is urgent! You must leave as soon as possible! Take my letter to Magister Rohmer at the temple in Gludio Castle Town.
Work has come from the guards that Langk Lizardmen are attacking travelers again! They must be dealt with immediately! Please give me Magister Rohmer's reply!

Go to the <font color="LEVEL">Langk Lizardmen Dwellings</font>, get <font color="LEVEL">50 dragon teeth</font> and bring them to me. Only the <font color="LEVEL">shamans and leaders</font> have the teeth. You'd better get started! Good luck!
Where is the letter from Magister Rohmer? We can't do anything without it! Did you drop it? You must find it!
Let me read the letter from Magister Iris.
Is seems the Langk Lizardmen in the south have obtained some very powerful sorcery. Take the notes I've collected in this letter back to Iris, she'll need them to complete her work.
Don't lose this letter, it's the only copy! It's very urgent, you must hurry!
Something's missing. The letter I gave you is useless without the sample I enclosed in it. You'd better bring it back.

The highway of the southern shoreline that leads to Giran has seen frequent attacks by Langk Lizardmen. People are scared. Even the temple priests traveling to Gludin were attacked! We Gludio guards are already stretched thin.

The highway of the southern shoreline that leads to Giran has seen frequent attacks by Langk Lizardman. People are scared. Even the temple priests traveling to Gludin were attacked! We need more experienced help.
